page_title: HAM 2-1 HEI | Hamburger SV v Heidenheim 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
90+5' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Omar Haktab Traore takes aim and his effort deflects off Adam Kolle (Heidenheim) to beat the goalkeeper. 2:1.
90+3' Hamburger SV force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Hamburger SV can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' Florian Exner has issued a yellow card to Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger).
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
86' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) replaces Giorgi Gocholeishvili.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ransford Konigsdorffer as he is replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).

85' A loose ball is pounced on by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is alert and makes a comfortable save.
84' The attendance is 57000.
83' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
80' Florian Exner shows the yellow card to Adam Kolle (Heidenheim) for a heavy challenge.
79' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Fabio Vieira will be replaced by Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).
78' Substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic makes his way off the pitch and Adam Kolle (Heidenheim) comes on as his replacement.
78' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen is replaced by Yannik Wagner (Heidenheim).
77' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
74' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Balde (Hamburger) replacing Jean-Luc Dompe.
74' That will be all from Rayan Philippe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger).
72' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) picks up a yellow card.

72' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Diant Ramaj thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
69' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger).
68' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) drills a shot towards goal after the ball is whipped into the penalty area, but it goes miles wide of the left post.
68' The game has come to an end for Benedikt Gimber. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
68' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan Schoppner and he is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).

66' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Diant Ramaj pulls off an easy save.
64' The foul by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Exner.
63' Great chance! Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar.
59' 2 - 0 Goal! Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and fires the ball past the goalkeeper.
58' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Exner had an easy-decision to make.
56' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar.
55' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
54' Substitution. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) in, Luca Kerber out.
53' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

53' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the top left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Diant Ramaj, who tips the ball over the bar.
52' The Hamburger SV players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes easily deals with the threat.
47' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Florian Exner blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' That was close by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Heidenheim couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
42' Hamburger SV earn a free kick.
41' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.

34' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Heidenheim manage to earn a corner.
29' Hamburger SV have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' A toe poke from Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) heads right for the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj is well placed and makes a good save. Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

25' Hamburger SV are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
22' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) for a tough tackle.
20' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) shoots from inside the box after his amazing individual effort. He beats the goalkeeper, but hits one of the defending players and it bounces away.
18' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a comfortable save.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hamburger SV, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Handball! A player from Heidenheim handled the ball. Hamburger SV have a free kick.
14' It's going to be a corner kick.
13' The resulting set piece from Hamburger SV is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

12' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the left post, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is alert and denies him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.
11' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim).
7' Heidenheim are ruled offside.
5' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Heidenheim.
4' Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
2' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hamburger SV will have the kick-off.
Florian Exner is the one to supervise the game today.
